## Working session summary

PR #349 is updated and marked ready for review: https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/pull/349. All CI checks pass on the latest commit (55cd76a): 69 jobs succeeded and only the two main-only jobs (`release`, `benchmarks / publish`) were skipped.

**What changed in this last stretch:**
- **C# PDF on ubuntu-26.04:** TeX Live 2025 on the new image bundles latexminted 0.6.0, which crashes on the system Python 3.14 (Launchpad bug 2154292, gpoore/minted#463).
  - The fixed latexminted 0.7.x needs a newer `minted.sty` than TeX Live 2025 ships (gpoore/minted#478), so the PDF job runs the bundled script on Python 3.13.
  - The PDF builds again and has 112 pages. The step prints a warning asking for its own removal once Ubuntu's package works again.
  - `experiments/issue-348/latexminted-python314.sh` reproduces the crash and the fix without TeX Live. I couldn't install TeX Live here (no root), so the full PDF build was only checked in CI.
- **Release audit errors on `main`:** before, they only said e.g. "java: 0.26.0 is absent from Maven Central". Each one now names the secrets or Packagist submission to set up and says to re-run the main CI run. The change is in `scripts/release-audit.mjs`, with a new test that failed before the fix.
- **Docs:** the analysis docs in `dev/log/issues/348/pulls/349` and the changelog record both fixes. I also corrected a note that wrongly said the audit already printed what to do.

**Still needs a maintainer on `main`** (CI on main fails with a message saying what to do):
- **Java 0.26.0 is not on Maven Central:** configure `CENTRAL_USERNAME`, `CENTRAL_TOKEN`, `GPG_PRIVATE_KEY` and `GPG_PASSPHRASE`, then re-run the main CI run.
- **PHP 0.26.0 is not on Packagist:** submit the repository once at https://packagist.org/packages/submit and configure `PACKAGIST_USERNAME` and `PACKAGIST_TOKEN`, then re-run.
- **The `cpp_0.26.0` release asset is an empty archive:** run `gh release delete-asset cpp_0.26.0 links-notation-cpp-0.26.0.tar.gz` and the same for its `.sha256`. I didn't do this from the PR because it changes a published release. The archive bug is fixed, so 0.27.0 will get a correct one.

The PR description now lists all eight defects the update uncovered, the dependencies left behind with reasons, and the upstream reports.

The branch is up to date with `main`, the working tree is clean, and the issue and PR have no comments or reviews.
